task_description: Add UI enhancements (favicon, loading spinner, dark mode themes, copy to clipboard) and Playwright E2E tests with GitHub Actions CI pipeline to the Instagram poster generator web app.

verification.summary: No build step needed (static site). All 10 Playwright E2E tests pass in 3.6s. Review fixes applied: spinner scoped to poster container, theme-aware export colors, 3 new tests (spinner, theme, clipboard), all waitForTimeout replaced with deterministic waits.
